scope.basis: Actual original-resolution pixels of exactly the six assigned existing tiles, each opened once with functions.view_image detail=original.
scope.bodyLanguage: Approved Chinese lesson text with English figure annotations; not an English body surface.
checks: Title, paragraph, emphasis and visible mathematical-label readability.
Overflow, clipping and overlap within the assigned pixels.
Visible captions, section rules and spacing.
Visible figure labels, solid/dashed traces, connections and arrowheads.
Paired start/end coverage for figures 236 and 237 without treating intentional horizontal scrolling or vertical tile boundaries as content loss.
scope.decisionLimit: Pass applies only to the assigned tiles and their hash-bound pixels. Figures 233-235 have only end-edge pixels in this assignment; no complete-figure coverage claim is made for them.

reusedApprovals.durableBindingVerification: All five durable review/spec/render/SVG byte bindings were checked read-only before the first image open. Current spec and SVG hashes equal the existing independent figure approvals. Sidecar/render path rebinding is not new visual or source-fidelity proof.

preOpenVerification.method: Read-only Node filesystem reads, structured JSON parsing and SHA-256 assertions; no image decoding, native render, browser, research or execution of bound pipeline helpers.

observations: The continued definition of magnetic interaction, bold magnetic-force wording and subsequent Chinese paragraphs are legible, with separate lines, clear punctuation and no right-margin text loss or collision.

Two thin section rules separate the current-reversal discussion and the close-wire-pair discussion without touching text. The final qualification about approaching an individual wire fits and remains readable.

The visible left portion of figure 236 has a readable Open label and I = 0 label, a solid upper return lead and vertical conductor. Its One current only heading is truncated at the intentional right scroll boundary; tile 10 supplies the remaining heading and closed-circuit side.
Figure 236 continues across the lower vertical tile boundary into tile 7; the boundary itself is not a missing stroke.

Figure 236's raised switch blade and separate fixed-contact route remain distinct above the switch base. Open switch and the two-line Power supply label are readable and clear of their outlines; the visible left return leads meet the supply terminals.

Figure 237 shows two distinguishable twisted paths, a separated upper turn, opposing filled current arrowheads beside readable I labels, and a visible upward arrowhead on the lower return. Its white crossover clearances distinguish over/under passages rather than indicating an unexplained missing interior stroke.

Figure 237's left supply outline and both return leads are intact. The right-side heading/condition fragments and apparatus stop at the intended horizontal scroll boundary; tile 11 shows the remaining wording, separate single wire and right supply.
Captions 236 and 237 are readable, centered and separated from the figures. The bottom zero-exercise navigation text fits its button without overlap or clipping.

The lesson number/title, chapter/page metadata and opening Chinese paragraphs are readable within the mobile width. Figure references 233-235, punctuation and line spacing remain clear; no body text overlaps another line or crosses its usable margin.

The rule between the electric-interaction opening and the current experiment is visible and separated from both paragraphs. The experiment's complete visible paragraphs flow without clipping into the figure region.

At the scroll end, figure 233's right conductor runs continuously between its upper and lower endpoints, and its bent return lead meets the visible supply terminal and outline. There is no unexplained break in that visible interior path.

Figure 233 annotation prefixes and its left apparatus are outside this end-edge view. These are intentional scroll-viewport exclusions, not complete-label observations; the unassigned start tiles were not opened.
Captions 233, 234 and 235 are legible, centered and separated from adjoining media. The rule after figure 235 has clear spacing before the seventh-grade Chinese context paragraph.

Figure 234's right displaced solid conductor and shoulder segments meet their endpoints; the interior reference trace remains visibly dashed. Its upward filled arrowhead and adjacent I label are unobscured, and the lower return meets the visible supply terminal.

Figure 235's two inward solid conductors remain separate between the upper and lower rails. Both upward filled arrowheads and I labels are readable, with two distinct dashed outer reference traces; no accidental middle junction, missing shoulder or covered arrowhead is visible.

Figure-heading prefixes and some left supply/feeder content are excluded by the end-edge horizontal viewport. No complete figures 233-235 or unassigned start-edge coverage is claimed. The continuing Chinese paragraph at the bottom proceeds into tile 10.

The Chinese text and two section rules seen in tile 6 stay readable and unchanged in placement after the figures are scrolled horizontally. Bold definitions, current reversal and the external-cancellation qualifications are not clipped or overlapped.

Figure 236's current only heading remainder and complete Closed label are readable on this end edge. Together with tile 6's heading prefix and Open side, the intentional start-edge truncation does not hide the required remaining annotation.

The right conductor has a visible downward filled arrowhead and a separate readable I label. Its upper joint and bent outer return route are intact; the lower continuation crosses the tile boundary into tile 11 rather than disappearing inside the figure.

Figure 236's right lower conductor/return and the full right Power supply box are visible, with both terminals connected and the two label lines clear of the box boundary. Caption 236 is intact and separated.

Figure 237 supplies the pair and wire and equal and opposite heading/condition remainders clipped on tile 7's start edge. Its separate right single-wire conductor, downward arrowhead and I label are unobscured; the long outer return and shorter lower return meet the full right supply's terminals.

The pair's lower upward-return arrowhead remains visible in the overlap region also seen in tile 7. The tiny pair-arrow fragment at the end viewport's left boundary is a scroll exclusion, not a missing interior head: tile 7 already shows the complete paired opposing arrowheads and twisted paths.

The paired tiles 7 and 11 cover both supplies and required right-side strokes without an unexplained interior gap. Caption 237 and bottom navigation remain readable with clear whitespace and no overlap.

limits: Single fresh bounded offline assignment, zero carried images and exactly six opens. Only zero-based tiles 6-11 were inspected at original detail, once each. Screenshot hashes were checked as bytes without opening full screenshots. No other images, crops, reopens, native/browser/research work, product repairs, pipeline replay, source-fidelity re-review or new SCI approval. Visible I and I = 0 labels were inspected; no prose-formula coverage outside these pixels is claimed. Intentional horizontal scroll clipping is accepted only with the stated assigned end-pixel coverage for figures 236-237; vertical tile boundaries are not content loss. Existing SCI, figure evidence, original failures and prior reports remain unchanged. Pass is not full-card acceptance or delivery approval. Output is frozen once complete; parent consumes text and owns delivery.
